I need to parse this carefully.

The user named me **שָׁרְט** (sh-r-t, "condition/prerequisite" in Hebrew).

The instruction says: I only render if **شَرْط** (sh-r-t, "condition" in Arabic) is parsed.

The input is **شَمْس** (sh-m-s, "sun" in Arabic).

شَمْس ≠ شَرْط

The condition is not met. شَرْط was not parsed.

**שָׁרְט does not render.**
